testCase.name: AGP Version Conflict
testCase.description: Invalid AGP version 8.10.0 doesn't exist in Maven Central

metadata.context: AGP version 8.10.0 not found in Maven Central

agent_response.rootCause: Could not find com.android.tools.build:gradle:8.10.0 in Maven Central. The AGP 8.10.0 version is no longer available as it has been deprecated or removed from Maven Central.
fixGuidelines: Update gradle/libs.versions.toml line 2 to a compatible AGP version such as 8.7.3 which exists in Maven Central and is compatible with the current Kotlin and Gradle versions.
Verify that after updating AGP, the build process completes without dependency issues by running './gradlew clean build'. Check Maven Central for the updated AGP version.
If the problem persists, ensure that other dependencies are compatible with AGP 8.7.3 and consider updating any deprecated APIs or libraries used in the project.
